editionLabel: Steve Jackson Games English rules, July 2009
firstPlayerRule: Whoever has the next upcoming birthday goes first.
houseFallback: If the next birthday is shared or unclear, agree to choose randomly among the tied players. This is this site's suggested house rule.
clarifications: Setup describes the player's zodiac sign, then explicitly explains the choice in terms of whose birthday comes next.
Play continues clockwise after the opening turn.
